287	| B4 | Tree paused (`get_tree().paused = true`): fuel does not burn (physics stops), `emitting` and `amount_ratio` unchanged; the GPU nodes inherit pause and freeze in place (Godot sets their speed scale to 0 on pause). Game menus do **not** pause the tree in this game: they stop `simulation_active()`, so fuel stops burning while the flames keep moving at a constant ratio. Both are asserted. |
288	| B5 | Hidden (`visible = false` on the pit or the effect root): nothing is drawn, but `emitting` and `amount_ratio` keep following `burn_left`; shown again, the fire is there at the current ratio. |
289	| B6 | Scene load: a fire already lit when its floor loads (the camp rest fire, the boss arena's first fire) has `emitting = true` from its first frame and, with preprocess, looks steady on the first drawn frame, not empty. |
290	| B7 | Presentation only: `burn_left`, warmth, cold and every existing expectation unchanged. |
291	
292	### Evidence split
293	
294	| Rule | How |
295	|---|---|
296	| B1–B3 | Headless state test (`tests/test_fire_pit_flames_state.gd`, 60 fps) on a real 萨米 floor: real fuel fed through the real E-interaction path, burning through the real physics loop, values set at least two ways (feed, burn), asserting `amount_ratio` and that `amount` never changes. |
297	| B4 | Same test, pausing the tree and opening a real menu modal. Freezing *on screen* is the user's check. |
298	| B5 | Same test (state); on screen the user's check. |
299	| B6 | Same test on the camp floor (state). First frames on screen: the user's check ("Scene load"). |
300	| B7 | Existing suites before and after. |
301	| Look | Strips (fixtures) and the user in play. |
302	
303	### Frame strip (Effect B)
304	
305	Preview `res://previews/fire_pit_flames_preview.tscn`: a real 萨米 floor with a
306	fixed seed, camera at default size, one `FirePit` in view. At frame 10 it is fed
307	120 s (ratio 1.0); at frame 55 `burn_left` is set to 24 s (ratio 0.44); at
308	frame 100 to 0 (out). `use_fixed_seed = true` on the preview's emitters.
309	Capture `--fixed-fps 30 --quit-after 180`. Frames to read:
310	**10, 12, 40, 54, 70, 99, 105, 130, 175**.
311	
312	| Frame | Prediction |
313	|---|---|
314	| 10 | lit on this frame; preprocess means a full fire (or, if the GPU lags a frame, nothing yet, then full at 11) |
315	| 12, 40, 54 | steady: ~24 flame quads stacked into an orange cone ~0.8 units tall, wavering; ~10 embers spread to ~2 units |
316	| 70 | thinner: about 10–11 flames, same height; fewer embers |
317	| 99 | same as 70 |
318	| 105 | flames thinning out (no new ones), embers still rising |
319	| 130 | no flames; a few embers high up |
320	| 175 | empty above the pit (the `Glow` halo already off since frame 100) |
321	
322	---
323	
324	## Predicted failures (whole brief)
325	
326	| # | Failure | Check that catches it |
327	|---|---|---|
328	| F1 | Godot 3 names in the scene (`ParticlesMaterial`, `initial_velocity`, `scale`, `scale_random`) leave settings at defaults; effect fires and looks default. **Caveat found in the audit:** 4.7's ClassDB still lists `initial_velocity` and `scale` on `ParticleProcessMaterial` (compatibility properties), so that mutation may load silently *and* map onto the new pair. | Config tests read every value back; the Step 2 mutation records whether the renamed property is translated. |
329	| F2 | 3D draw material missing `vertex_color_use_as_albedo` (ramp invisible), `TRANSPARENCY_ALPHA` (no fade), or `BILLBOARD_PARTICLES` (edge-on quads) | Config tests assert all three on every emitter; strip r0 would show white squares. |
330	| F3 | Dropped retrigger: one shared one-shot node and `emitting = true` while still emitting silently drops the second hit | Overlap design; state test A2 (two hits, two nodes). |
331	| F4 | Popping feedback loop: writing `amount` restarts the buffer | State test B3 asserts `amount` constant and `amount_ratio` moving; strip frame 54→70 must show no gap. |
332	| F5 | Freed parent: burst parented to the enemy dies with it | State test A4 with a 1-HP enemy. |
333	| F6 | Visibility AABB too small: sparks or embers clipped at screen edge | Strips; the user's edge-of-screen check. |
334	| F7 | No preprocess: camp fire starts empty on every floor load | Config test (preprocess values); B6 state; the user's scene-load check. |
335	| F8 | Cost script measures itself (same number for every case) | Empty-scene control in `tests/cost_effects.gd`. |
336	
337	## Price predictions and budget
338	
339	Peak particle counts: A = 8 bursts × (1 + 14 + 4) = **152**; B = one pit at
340	ratio 1.0 = **34** (a floor has at most 3–4 pits, ≤ 136; priced for one and for
341	four).
342	
343	| | Headless CPU (mean ms/frame over control) | GPU time (Visual Profiler, RTX 4060, 1280×720) | Budget | Compared on |
344	|---|---|---|---|---|
345	| A at 8 bursts | +0.02 ms (node bookkeeping only; the dummy renderer runs no particle process) | +0.05 ms | **0.25 ms GPU** | GPU time |
346	| B, one pit / four pits | +0.005 / +0.02 ms | +0.02 / +0.06 ms | **0.15 ms GPU** for four pits | GPU time |
347	
348	Both are GPU nodes, so the headless number is expected to sit inside the
349	control's spread and is reported but not judged against the budget.
350	
351	## Answers
352	
353	1. **Node types and missing features.** Both effects use `GPUParticles3D`
354	   (4.7.2). Checked in ClassDB: it has `amount_ratio`, `preprocess`,
355	   `use_fixed_seed`/`seed`, `visibility_aabb`, `local_coords`, trails;
356	   `ParticleProcessMaterial` has turbulence, damping, `scale_curve`,
357	   `color_ramp`, `alpha_curve`, hue variation. Nothing this brief names is
358	   missing. `CPUParticles3D` would lack `amount_ratio` and turbulence, which is
359	   why B moves to GPU.
360	2. **`local_coords = false`, parent moves after the event.** Effect A's root is
361	   a child of the `GameManager` (the world) placed at the hit point; it never
362	   moves. If the struck enemy keeps walking, the burst stays where the blow
363	   landed. If the world root itself moved, particles already emitted would stay
364	   in world space and only new ones (none — it is one-shot) would follow.
365	3. **Bursts alive at once.** Overlap, 0.45 s life. Expected peak 6 in play,
366	   priced at 8 → 152 particles.
367	4. **Headless price of a GPU effect.** Near zero above the control: headless
368	   uses a dummy renderer, so the particle process shader never runs and nothing
369	   is drawn; only node `_process` bookkeeping is on the CPU. With vsync on, FPS
370	   reads the display refresh rate both with the effect off and on, because the
371	   frame is far under budget either way; only GPU time (or FPS with vsync off)
372	   can show the difference.
373	5. **Effect B, first frame / paused / hidden.** With preprocess: a lit pit shows
374	   a full fire on its first drawn frame. Without: empty, filling over 0.8 s
375	   (flames) and 2.2 s (embers), on every floor load. Tree paused: frozen in
376	   place, still drawn. Hidden: not drawn; state keeps following `burn_left`.
377	6. **Emission / process / draw.**
378	   *Emission:* `amount`, `amount_ratio`, `one_shot`, `explosiveness`,
379	   `lifetime`, `randomness`, `preprocess`, `emitting`, `emission_shape` and
380	   its radius (the shape lives on the process material in 4.x but decides where
381	   particles appear). *Process:* direction, spread, initial velocity, gravity,
382	   damping, turbulence, `scale_min/max`, `scale_curve`, `color_ramp`, hue
383	   variation, angle, `local_coords`. *Draw:* `draw_pass_1` QuadMesh and its
384	   size, the `StandardMaterial3D` (unshaded, billboard particles, vertex colour
385	   as albedo, transparency, blend mode, fog), the gradient texture, and
386	   `visibility_aabb` (culling of the draw).
387	
388	## Boundaries
389	
390	Unchanged: collision, movement, input, the enemy and player state machines and
391	their timings, damage, hitstop, aggro, charge, `burn_left` and every rule that
392	reads it (warmth, cold, fuel values), existing test expectations, the A5
393	shaders in `shaders/` (only `shaders/particles_generated.gdshader` may be added
394	in Step 6), every other object, and the source texture files. The existing mesh
395	`CombatVfx` spark stays as it is; the fire pit's `Glow` halo and model stay.
396	Presentation code reads game state; it never writes it.
397	
398	## Revisions
399	
400	(none yet)

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# scripts/run-test.sh <test-file.gd> <fps|realtime> [timeout-seconds]
3	# The A6 course wrapper, adapted to this repository: the Godot project is the
4	# repository root (--path .), and Godot is not on PATH here, so GODOT defaults
5	# to the console build three folders above the project (D:\CSYE 7370).
6	# "realtime" runs without --fixed-fps (for tests that wait on audio). The
7	# optional third argument sets the timeout; TEST_TIMEOUT is still honoured
8	# when it is absent, so the A5 slow-suite commands keep working.
9	set -o pipefail
10	cd "$(dirname "$0")/.."
11	GODOT="${GODOT:-$(cd ../../../../.. && pwd)/Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64_console.exe}"
12	mkdir -p logs
13	if [ "$2" = "realtime" ]; then
14		fps_args=(); tag="realtime"
15	else
16		fps_args=(--fixed-fps "$2"); tag="${2}fps"
17	fi
18	log="logs/$(basename "$1" .gd)_${tag}.log"
19	timeout "${3:-${TEST_TIMEOUT:-120}}" "$GODOT" --headless "${fps_args[@]}" --path . --script "res://tests/$1" 2>&1 | tee "$log"
20	status=$?
21	if grep -qE "SHADER ERROR|SCRIPT ERROR" "$log"; then status=1; fi
22	exit $status

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# scripts/run-baseline.sh <label> [jobs]
3	# Runs every tests/test_*.gd through scripts/run-test.sh at 60 fps (the pinned
4	# mode for every existing suite, CLAUDE.md), several at once, and writes
5	# logs/baseline-<label>/summary.txt with one "PASS|FAIL <exit> <test>" line each.
6	# Slow suites get a 1200 s timeout, the rest 300 s.
7	cd "$(dirname "$0")/.."
8	label="$1"; jobs="${2:-10}"
9	out="logs/baseline-$label"; mkdir -p "$out"
10	slow=" test_bosses.gd test_elevation.gd test_layout.gd test_run_save.gd test_v1.gd "
11	run_one() {
12		t="$1"; out="$2"; slow="$3"
13		limit=300; case "$slow" in *" $t "*) limit=1200;; esac
14		./scripts/run-test.sh "$t" 60 "$limit" > "$out/${t%.gd}.log" 2>&1
15		code=$?
16		if [ $code -eq 0 ]; then echo "PASS $code $t"; else echo "FAIL $code $t"; fi
17	}
18	export -f run_one
19	ls tests | grep -E '^test_.*\.gd$' | xargs -P "$jobs" -I{} bash -c 'run_one "$@"' _ {} "$out" "$slow" | sort -k3 > "$out/summary.txt"
20	echo "$(grep -c '^PASS' "$out/summary.txt") of $(wc -l < "$out/summary.txt") pass" | tee -a "$out/summary.txt"

4	## 萨米's 火堆 (地图特色策划案 §5.3): a ring of stones round charred birch, a bone
5	## charm on a stick. Cold until she lights it with E and a piece of fuel from
6	## the pack; it burns as long as the fuel lasts (FeatureCatalog.FUELS, at most
7	## FIRE_MAX), and inside FIRE_RADIUS the cold falls. Out, it is cold again and
8	## can be lit again. No name; the HUD shows only the E key.
9	
10	const MODEL := "res://art/kit/snow_fire_pit.glb"
11	const FLAME := Color(1.0, 0.55, 0.18)
12	## The warm pool of its light on the ground (additive), and how it flickers.
13	const GLOW := Color(0.95, 0.5, 0.2)
14	const GLOW_GAIN := 0.55
15	const FLICKER := 7.0
16	
17	var burn_left := 0.0
18	var _flames: CPUParticles3D
19	var _embers: CPUParticles3D
20	var _glow: StandardMaterial3D
21	var _time := 0.0
22	
23	func _ready() -> void:
24		add_to_group("fire_pits")
25		if ResourceLoader.exists(MODEL):
26			var model := MeshInstance3D.new()
27			model.name = "Model"
28			model.mesh = TerraceDressing.kit_mesh(load(MODEL))
29			add_child(model)
30		else:
31			_placeholder()
32		var halo := TracePoint.halo(FeatureCatalog.FIRE_RADIUS * 2.0)
33		halo.name = "Glow"
34		_glow = halo.material_override
35		_glow.albedo_color = Color.BLACK
36		add_child(halo)
37		_flames = _particles(18, 0.7, 0.18, Vector2(0.5, 1.1), 0.22, [Color(1.0, 0.85, 0.4, 0.0), Color(1.0, 0.6, 0.2, 0.9), Color(0.8, 0.2, 0.05, 0.0)])
38		_flames.name = "Flames"
39		_flames.position.y = 0.2
40		_embers = _particles(8, 2.2, 0.25, Vector2(0.4, 0.9), 0.05, [Color(1.0, 0.7, 0.3, 0.0), Color(1.0, 0.5, 0.15, 0.9), Color(0.6, 0.15, 0.05, 0.0)])
41		_embers.name = "Embers"
42		_embers.position.y = 0.35
43		_set_lit(false)
44	
45	## Stones, logs and the charm in plain shapes until the model is in.
46	func _placeholder() -> void:
47		var stone := StandardMaterial3D.new()
48		stone.albedo_color = Color("6e7378")
49		stone.roughness = 1.0
50		for i in range(9):
51			var rock := MeshInstance3D.new()
52			var mesh := SphereMesh.new()
53			mesh.radius = 0.16
54			mesh.height = 0.22
55			rock.mesh = mesh
56			rock.material_override = stone
57			var a := TAU * i / 9.0
58			rock.position = Vector3(cos(a) * 0.55, 0.08, sin(a) * 0.55)
59			add_child(rock)
60		var wood := StandardMaterial3D.new()
61		wood.albedo_color = Color("2b2420")
62		for i in range(3):
63			var stick := MeshInstance3D.new()
64			var mesh := CylinderMesh.new()
65			mesh.top_radius = 0.06
66			mesh.bottom_radius = 0.07
67			mesh.height = 0.8
68			stick.mesh = mesh
69			stick.material_override = wood
70			stick.position.y = 0.12
71			stick.rotation = Vector3(PI / 2.0, TAU * i / 3.0, 0.0)
72			add_child(stick)
73	
74	func _particles(amount: int, lifetime: float, radius: float, speed: Vector2, size: float, ramp: Array) -> CPUParticles3D:
75		var p := CPUParticles3D.new()
76		p.amount = amount
77		p.lifetime = lifetime
78		p.emission_shape = CPUParticles3D.EMISSION_SHAPE_SPHERE
79		p.emission_sphere_radius = radius
80		p.direction = Vector3.UP
81		p.spread = 15.0
82		p.gravity = Vector3.ZERO
83		p.initial_velocity_min = speed.x
84		p.initial_velocity_max = speed.y
85		var fade := Gradient.new()
86		fade.set_color(0, ramp[0])
87		fade.add_point(0.3, ramp[1])
88		fade.set_color(fade.get_point_count() - 1, ramp[2])
89		p.color_ramp = fade
90		var quad := QuadMesh.new()
91		quad.size = Vector2(size, size)
92		var material := StandardMaterial3D.new()
93		material.shading_mode = BaseMaterial3D.SHADING_MODE_UNSHADED
94		material.transparency = BaseMaterial3D.TRANSPARENCY_ALPHA
95		material.blend_mode = BaseMaterial3D.BLEND_MODE_ADD
96		# Fog on an additive quad lights its whole square.
97		material.disable_fog = true
98		material.vertex_color_use_as_albedo = true
99		material.billboard_mode = BaseMaterial3D.BILLBOARD_ENABLED
100		quad.material = material
101		p.mesh = quad
102		add_child(p)
103		return p
104	
105	func lit() -> bool:
106		return burn_left > 0.0
107	
108	## Inside its warmth (flat distance).
109	func warms(at: Vector3) -> bool:
110		return Vector2(at.x - global_position.x, at.z - global_position.z).length() <= FeatureCatalog.FIRE_RADIUS
111	
112	## Fuel on: lit if it was out, burning longer if it was not.
113	func feed(seconds: float) -> void:
114		burn_left = minf(FeatureCatalog.FIRE_MAX, burn_left + seconds)
115		_set_lit(true)
116	
117	func burn(delta: float) -> void:
118		if burn_left <= 0.0: return
119		burn_left = maxf(0.0, burn_left - delta)
120		if burn_left <= 0.0: _set_lit(false)
121	
122	func _set_lit(on: bool) -> void:
123		if _flames != null: _flames.emitting = on
124		if _embers != null: _embers.emitting = on
125		if _glow != null and not on: _glow.albedo_color = Color.BLACK
126	
127	func _process(delta: float) -> void:
128		if not lit() or _glow == null: return
129		_time += delta
130		var flicker := 0.85 + 0.1 * sin(_time * FLICKER) + 0.05 * sin(_time * FLICKER * 2.7)
131		_glow.albedo_color = GLOW * GLOW_GAIN * flicker

197		return true

# CLAUDE.md — downfall-godot (Assignment 6: particle effects)

## Project context

- Engine: Godot 4.7.2-stable. The wrapper runs `Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64_console.exe`
  five folders above the repo, `D:\CSYE 7370` (`scripts/run-test.sh:11`; `CHANGE-BRIEF.md:9`).
  `project.godot:16` only records the feature tag `"4.7"`. The repo root is the
  Godot project (`--path .`, `scripts/run-test.sh:10,19`).
- Renderer: Forward+ with D3D12 on Windows (`README.md:3`, `CHANGE-BRIEF.md:9`).
  `project.godot` `[rendering]` sets no `rendering_method`, only
  `rendering_device/driver.windows="d3d12"` (`project.godot:24-27`). `tests/run_all.ps1:70`
  forces `gl_compatibility` on the older visual suites. `scripts/run-test.sh` does not.
- Main scene: `res://game/main.tscn` (`project.godot:15`). It holds one `PixelDisplay` node
  (`game/main.tscn:5-6`). That node builds a `SubViewport` (`game/pixel_display.gd:22`),
  creates the `GameManager` (`:44`) and adds it to the viewport (`:80`). Field maps are
  built in code, not in scenes.
- Effect A `hit_spark`: three `GPUParticles3D` nodes under a `Node3D` root `HitSpark`, in
  `res://effects/hit_spark.tscn` (`CHANGE-BRIEF.md:44-48,94`).

  (`game/main.tscn:5-6`). That node makes a `SubViewport`, creates the `GameManager` and adds it
  to the viewport (`game/pixel_display.gd:22,44,80`). Field maps are built in code, not scenes.
- Effect A `hit_spark`: three `GPUParticles3D` under a `Node3D` named `HitSpark`, in
  `res://effects/hit_spark.tscn` (`CHANGE-BRIEF.md:44-48,94`).
  - Event: a landed operator melee hit, a direct call, not a signal. Each site in
    `entities/player.gd` calls `CombatVfx.spawn(game, <enemy>.global_position, direction,
    "spark"|"amiya_spark")`: the basic hit in `attack_direction()` (`:838`, `:901-914`);
    拉普兰德's cross cut in `_lappland_cross()` (`:947-962`); 阿米娅's cut in `_amiya_cut()`
    (`:1762-1768`). Her later cuts are queued 0.08 s apart (`:80`, `:1756-1758`, `:1798-1802`).
  - The current spark is not a particle system: unlit meshes in `game/combat_vfx.gd:163-192`.
  - Related signal: `Enemy.died(enemy)` (`entities/enemy.gd:12`), emitted at `:1500` just
    before `queue_free()` at `:1501`.
  - Appears on field floors, parented to the `GameManager`, never to the enemy
    (`CHANGE-BRIEF.md:132-133`).
- Effect B `fire_pit_flames`: two `GPUParticles3D` under a `Node3D` named `FirePitFlames`, in
  `res://effects/fire_pit_flames.tscn` (`CHANGE-BRIEF.md:200-201,237`). It replaces the
  code-made `CPUParticles3D` "Flames" and "Embers" (`entities/fire_pit.gd:18-19,37-42,74-103`).
  - Condition: `FirePit.burn_left` (`entities/fire_pit.gd:17`). The pit is lit while `lit()`
    is true (`burn_left > 0`, `:105-106`). `FirePit` declares no signals.
  - Fuel goes up through `feed()` (`:113-115`). Callers: the player picking fuel with E
    (`game/gm_features.gd:227`), the boss arena's first fire (`:152`), and the camp rest fire
    (`game/gm_route.gd:225`).
  - Fuel goes down through `burn()` (`entities/fire_pit.gd:117-120`). Callers: `_tick_features()`
    (`game/gm_features.gd:114-116`), which `GameManager._physics_process()` runs only while
    `simulation_active()` is true (`game/game_manager.gd:441-442,848-853`); and the boss hammer
    (`entities/boss.gd:1724-1728`).
  - Constants: `FIRE_RADIUS` 4.5 and `FIRE_MAX` 300 (`game/feature_catalog.gd:91,95`).
  - Appears on 萨米 (`snow`) floors only (`game/gm_features.gd:143`). Pits are added in code
    under `world_map._generated_root`: ordinary floors (`:180-182`), the boss arena
    (`:145-152`) and the camp rest stop (`game/gm_route.gd:218-226`).

  - It runs `--headless [--fixed-fps N] --path . --script res://tests/<file>`, logs to
    `logs/<name>_<N>fps.log` or `logs/<name>_realtime.log`, and times out after `$3`, else
    `TEST_TIMEOUT`, else 120 s. A non-zero exit or a `SHADER ERROR`/`SCRIPT ERROR` line fails
    the run (`scripts/run-test.sh:2,13-22`).
